rawOutput:
[blocker] `tsconfig.json:13-22` — `apps/` is not excluded from the repo-root `tsconfig.json` (which inherits `"include": ["${configDir}/**/*"]` from `astro/tsconfigs/strict`) — running root `pnpm build` (and Vercel deploys via `vercel.json:4`) executes `astro check` over `apps/web/src/**`, `apps/web/emdash-env.d.ts`, and `apps/web/worker-configuration.d.ts` under root's legacy Astro 7.3.3 `node_modules` (missing `emdash` and `@emdash-cms/cloudflare`), failing typecheck and breaking legacy blog builds.

[blocker] `apps/web/package.json:27-31` — `apps/web` declares `@astrojs/check: ^0.9.10` (peer `typescript: ^5.0.0 || ^6.0.0`) without declaring `typescript`, so `pnpm-lock.yaml:331-333` resolves its peer to `typescript@7.0.2` (the native `tsgo` package whose entry `lib/version.cjs` only exports `version` and `versionMajorMinor`, unlike root's `npm:@typescript/typescript6@^6.0.2`) — running `pnpm --filter web typecheck` (`astro check`) passes `require.resolve('typescript')` to `AstroCheck` and crashes immediately because the TypeScript JS compiler API is absent.

[blocker] `apps/web/package.json:14` — `"deploy": "astro build && wrangler deploy"` omits `-c dist/server/wrangler.json` despite `apps/web/TEMPLATE_DIFF.md:37` documenting that the repo-root legacy `wrangler.json` (`"name": "growgen"`) breaks Wrangler's generated-config redirect — running `pnpm --filter web deploy` fails config resolution or targets the wrong config instead of `dist/server/wrangler.json`.

[major] `apps/web/astro.config.mjs:9` — bare `adapter: cloudflare()` defaults `imageService` to `"cloudflare-binding"` and auto-injects `"images": { "binding": "IMAGES" }` plus an ID-less `"kv_namespaces": [{ "binding": "SESSION" }]` into `apps/web/dist/server/wrangler.json` — on a Cloudflare Workers Free account without Images Transformations enabled (or once media moves to Cloudinary), `wrangler deploy` rejects the `IMAGES` binding (or `/_image` fails at runtime), and non-interactive CI deploys fail or create an untracked `SESSION` KV namespace missing from `wrangler.jsonc`.

[major] `apps/web/worker-configuration.d.ts:4-9` — `Cloudflare.Env` still declares the template's removed D1 binding (`DB: D1Database`) and omits `HYPERDRIVE`, `EMDASH_ROOMS`, `SESSION`, and `ASSETS` — because `apps/web/tsconfig.json:6` includes this file, code accessing `env.HYPERDRIVE` or `env.EMDASH_ROOMS` fails `astro check`, while references to removed `env.DB` pass typecheck and throw at runtime.

[major] `apps/web/package.json:24-25` — `"react": "19.2.4"` and `"react-dom": "19.2.4"` are exact-pinned below the monorepo's `^19.2.6` (used by root `package.json:104-105` and `packages/{layouts,react,shadcn,particle-hero}`) — importing any shared React workspace package into `apps/web` pulls two React copies (`19.2.4` and `19.2.6`) into the graph, causing invalid hook call / null dispatcher errors at SSR or hydration time.

[major] `apps/web/wrangler.jsonc:3,11,18` — template placeholders remain in checked-in config (`"name": "my-emdash-site"`, `"id": "00000000000000000000000000000000"`, and `"bucket_name": "my-emdash-media"` with `r2({ binding: "MEDIA" })` in `apps/web/astro.config.mjs:18`) — any real `wrangler deploy` fails against the nonexistent Hyperdrive ID and fails on a Free account where R2 is not activated (requires billing setup) or the placeholder bucket does not exist.

[major] `.oxlintrc.json:3-9` — `ignorePatterns` only ignores root-level `.astro/**` and `dist/**`, not `apps/web/dist/**`, `apps/web/.astro/**`, or the 12k-line generated `apps/web/worker-configuration.d.ts`, and root `pnpm fmt:check` (`oxfmt --check`) has no ignore for `apps/web`'s tab-indented files vs. root's 2-space style — running root `pnpm lint` after building `apps/web` lints compiled output, and `pnpm fmt:check` fails across `apps/web/`.

[minor] `apps/web/wrangler.jsonc:22-33` — `EMDASH_ROOMS` Durable Object (`EmDashRoom`, SQLite-backed) is bound even though `coEditing` is disabled by default in `apps/web/astro.config.mjs`, and `triggers.crons: ["* * * * *"]` runs `runScheduledTasks` every minute — deploying provisions an unused Durable Object class and triggers ~1,440 Worker + Hyperdrive/Supabase Postgres invocations per day (43,200/month) on the Free plan even with no scheduled content.

[minor] `package.json:6-8` — root `"workspaces": ["packages/*"]` omits `"apps/*"` even though `pnpm-workspace.yaml:1-3` adds it — tools that read `package.json#workspaces` instead of `pnpm-workspace.yaml` (IDE resolvers, dependency/dead-code scanners, or npm-compatible CLIs) will not treat `apps/web` as a workspace package.
